svg.title: Issue 7 — Page 22 — FAIRY TALE ECHO: keeper tells his story, harbor men laugh, journalist writes it down — folklore enters the record, truth hides inside it like light inside a lens
svg.desc: Page 22, 4 panels — Issue 7 finale. Top: full-width dawn waterfront, keeper telling story to skeptical harbor men, brazier the only warm note. Tier 2: wide group with the journalist writing in his notebook + narrow notebook page macro showing the underlined connection. Bottom: full-width final image — mundane morning resumes, journalist walks away, on a distant barge a shimmer of dark iridescence at the edge of perception.
